goal: Inventory legacy router decision surfaces before migrating them into observation slots, replay expectations, and deterministic rule gates.
migration_policy: No new legacy decision surface may be added without an inventory entry.
High-risk surfaces must require replay coverage before behavior changes.
High-risk surfaces must appear in daily review packs as migration priorities.
Provider or queue-affecting surfaces must preserve Router Decision Framework rule_gate metadata.
Department workflow surfaces must remain context-constrained unless an approved replay locks active workflow dispatch.

acceptance_tests.title: Legacy surface inventory covers all contract-required surfaces
High-risk surfaces require replay before migration
Inventory counts stay aligned with current router tables
Daily review packs include high-risk legacy surface priorities
